description: TlsError::source() returns None for CertParse(_). The CertParse variant carries a String, losing the x509-parser parse error. Like OidcError, using thiserror with #[source] would preserve the error chain. The other variants (CertLoad, KeyLoad) correctly chain the io::Error.
title: tls: TlsError does not implement std::error::Error::source for CertParse variant
